Cloud Platform Engineer

Company: Northstar Systems
Employment type: Full time
Location: Wellington

About the role
- Build and support cloud infrastructure on Azure.
- Improve deployment, access control, and incident response.
- Work closely with engineering teams on Docker and Kubernetes platforms.

Requirements
- Strong experience with Azure, Cloud Infrastructure, Docker, and Kubernetes.
- Experience with Linux, networking, and troubleshooting.
- Good communication and ownership.
